Maya: Aisha K submitted her take-home. Repo: https://git.company/aisha-takehome. She finished tests locally. Need panel scheduling and two reviewers. Options: Tue 2024-06-11 10:00 PT or Wed 2024-06-12 13:00 PT. 45m interview + 15m debrief. @Samir @Priya would you be available? Also need a scribe.
Samir: I can do Tue 10am PT. I'll cover system design + infra. :+1:
Priya: I can take the code review asynchronously — will run tests and write notes by Mon EOD. Prefer if the interview focuses on tradeoffs and edge cases.
Jordan: Quick rubric question: do we weight correctness more than design for this role?
Elena: For this mid-senior SWE I'd do 50% correctness, 35% design/ops, 15% communication. We should use the 'takehome debrief' template. Link: https://confluence/redwood/takehome-debrief
Maya: Agreed. Let's lock Tue then. @Iris can you send invites to Aisha + panel? @Samir please be scribe unless you'd prefer otherwise.
Samir: Happy to scribe. Also FYI tests run with `pytest -q` and there's a small flake in test 07 — ignore for grading. Here's run command:
```bash
python -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
pytest -q
```
Iris: I'll send calendar invites once you confirm panel list. Also reminder: add scores to Greenhouse within 48h and paste debrief notes there. :memo:
Priya: Will upload a short review to the debrief doc and flag any security concerns. If we need sample Qs, use these: 1) Why this data model? 2) How would you scale X? 3) Walk me through a failure mode.
Maya: Thanks all. Final panel: Samir (system design + scribe), Priya (code review), Jordan (behavioral). Invites pending. Last ask: please capture one line 'pass/hold/reject' and 3 bullets in debrief.
calendar-bot: Invite created: Aisha K interview — Tue Jun 11 10:00 PT. Added Zoom link.
